text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Good-mile-ning, Hanshin Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Hanshin Cup began with Gran 
Alegria's usual energetic greeting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shouting with all your might gets you 
fired up. Having joined in on her personal 
rule, I've gradually come to understand 
its effect.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"My Rules" have a major impact on Gran 
Alegria's mood.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Today was 0.825 miles, right? That's 
pretty much a whole mile♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Still, I'll run as if it's 0.75 miles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, our goal is the Sprint G1 after 
this. Getting a feel for sprinting in this 
race is crucial.”
choice_data_list:
It's a sprint, so watch out for a slow 
start

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A bunch of speed demons are gathered here, 
after all. I know what I'm up against!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Well, no one's faster than me. But that 
doesn't mean I'll let my guard down!
choice_data_list: You're in high spirits again today, but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I won't make the same mistake I made at 
the NHK Mile Cup!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I have—a secret plan, you see☆

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
――Now then! My personal rule: "Before an 
important race"...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Deep breath in...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(Close my mouth tightly... and breathe out 
slowly, deeply...)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(Inhale... exhale... Circulate the breath 
through my entire body...)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
(And then... walk in rhythm with my 
breathing.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After stopping and catching her breath 
repeatedly, Gran Alegria starts walking 
with her head slightly down.
choice_data_list:
That rule of mine, it's from the other 
day...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was a new one established when she 
went searching for "My Rules."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With each and every step she plants... I 
can feel Gran Alegria's concentration 
sharpening.
choice_data_list: So that's what my rule was for!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My personal rules for getting into the 
right mental headspace before a race.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"—I'll stabilize my 'feel' with these 
personal rules. So that it won't waver, 
even at medium distance."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer, I'll help you remember."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...that I am Gran Alegria!
